title: tc-instruction-editor
description:
System and developer instructions with highlighted variables, missing and unused variable warnings, an
app-supplied token count, a diff against a chosen version and Save as a new version.

heading.description: The heading, and the group's name

value.description: The role and the text. Changed by the user unless tc-value-change is prevented

roles.description: Which instructions these can be; fewer than two hides the switch

variables.description: The variables the app fills in; the text is checked against them

versions.description: Saved versions, oldest first. Grows when Save isn't prevented

compareTo.description: The id of the version the text is compared with; unset compares with the latest

tokenCount.description: The text's length in tokens, as the app counts it; unset shows no count

tokenLimit.description: The most tokens the instructions should use; past it the count turns red

counting.description: The app is counting the tokens for the latest text

name.description: Submitted with the form: the text

readonly.description: Shows everything but nothing can be changed

InstructionVariable.description: A variable the app fills in at run time

note.description: What changed, in the author's words

role.description: Which instructions these are – a role id, "system" or "developer" by default
